scene: The brass automaton pours frothy cocoa into a painted ceramic mug.
picture: Flat side view. Along one ground line: on the far left, the brass robot holds out a steaming ceramic mug on its tray; the player in corduroy jacket and beanie stands left of centre watching it; a star-shaped cocoa cart stands in the centre with a paper schedule pinned; on the far right, an open spiral staircase leads downward.
shown: a freshly poured steaming ceramic mug sitting on the robot's tray at far left
a curled paper schedule pinned under a magnet on the cart in the centre
a winding iron staircase leading downward on the far right
